# EveryCRSReport.com

> > Free public access to all Congressional Research Service reports with comprehensive coverage of U.S. policy, law, trade, defense, and government operations.

EveryCRSReport.com provides a searchable database of Congressional Research Service (CRS) reports, which are authoritative, non-partisan research documents prepared for members of Congress. The site includes topic directories, bulk download capabilities, and rankings of most-viewed reports covering defense, trade policy, constitutional law, and government appropriations.

## Key Topics

- Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- U.S. Congress
- Constitutional Law
- Trade Policy
- Separation of Powers
- Government Research
- Legal Analysis
- Policy Database
- Foreign Terrorist Organizations
- Defense & Military
- Appropriations
- China Trade Relations
- NATO
- Iran
- Non-Partisan Information

## Core Navigation & Discovery

- [EveryCRSReport.com Homepage](https://www.everycrsreport.com): Main portal for accessing all Congressional Research Service reports with search and browsing capabilities
- [CRS Report Topic Areas](https://www.everycrsreport.com/topics.html): Organized topic directory for browsing CRS reports by policy categories and research areas
- [Most Viewed Reports](https://www.everycrsreport.com/most-viewed-reports.html): Weekly rankings of the most accessed CRS reports on the platform
- [About EveryCRSReport.com](https://www.everycrsreport.com/about.html): Information about the EveryCRSReport mission, team, and nonprofit partners

## Trade Policy & Economic Analysis

- [Congressional and Presidential Authority to Impose Import Tariffs](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R48435.html): CRS analysis of congressional and presidential tariff authority under U.S. trade law
- [U.S.-South Korea Bilateral Trade Relations](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/IF10733.html): CRS examination of U.S.-South Korea trade relations and KORUS FTA implementation
- [China's Economic Rise: History, Trends, Challenges, and Implications](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/RL33534.html): CRS comprehensive report on China's economic growth and implications for U.S.-China trade relations

## Constitutional Law & Separation of Powers

- [Separation of Powers and NATO Withdrawal](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R48868.html): CRS constitutional analysis of presidential and congressional authority over NATO withdrawal decisions
- [Litigation Over the Trump Administration's Grant Terminations](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/LSB11407.html): CRS legal analysis of litigation surrounding Trump Administration federal grant terminations

## Defense & National Security

- [U.S. Military Operations Against Iran: Munitions and Missile Defense](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/IN12668.html): CRS report on U.S. military operations against Iran and defense strategy analysis
- [Navy Littoral Combat Ship (LCS) Program: Background and Issues for Congress](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/RL33741.html): CRS analysis of Navy LCS program, procurement challenges, and shipbuilding strategy
- [The Foreign Terrorist Organization (FTO) List](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/IF10613.html): CRS overview of Foreign Terrorist Organization designations and State Department designation process

## Government Appropriations & Budget

- [Overview of FY2026 Appropriations for the Census Bureau](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/IF13105.html): CRS report analyzing FY2026 Census Bureau budget appropriations and funding allocations
- [FY2026 Appropriations for EPA Water Infrastructure Programs](https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/IF13177.html): CRS analysis of FY2026 EPA water infrastructure funding and program allocations

## Developer Resources & Data Access

- [Bulk Download / Developer Documentation](https://www.everycrsreport.com/download.html): API documentation and bulk download guide for accessing CRS reports in CSV and JSON formats
